title: Least tensor-supporting submodule for a flat Mittag-Leffler module
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $M$ a flat Mittag-Leffler $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map, def-trf-mittag-leffler-module]. For every $R$-module $E$ and every $x\in E\otimes_R M$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], there exists a smallest submodule $E_0\subseteq E$ such that $x$ belongs to the image of $E_0\otimes_R M\to E\otimes_R M$ induced by inclusion; moreover this smallest submodule $E_0$ is a finite $R$-module.
